``` ::: ::: ::: #### 🙋‍♀️ Volunteer to contribute {#volunteer} We are looking for volunteers to help lead parts of the workshop. If you are interested, get in touch! **Opportunities include:** - Session chairs and general facilitators - Delivering *Lecture 3: What is MSE?* (~45 min) on Monday - Leading a *Curated Narrative Session* on Tuesday Curated narrative sessions will consist of a 20–25 min presentation with ~20 min discussion Possible themes: - **Navigating data-limited situations** → How you selected and applied an approach - **Working across jurisdictions on shared stocks** → Coordination challenges and solutions - **When standard approaches don’t fit** → Adapting methods to unusual situations - **Building stakeholder trust through assessment** → Communication and transparency - **From problem to solution: a challenging assessment journey** → Lessons learned from a difficult case #### 🎤 Lightning round {#lightning} Prepare a short introduction (~2 minutes): - your name - your organisation - one current challenge - one thing you hope to learn #### 🖼️ Poster session {#poster} As a jurisdiction, bring a poster representing your work, team, or context. This is intentionally flexible! Ideas include: - a flagship stock assessment - a challenging case study - your team and region ("getting to know us") - a methodological innovation - a collaboration success story
